title: chore: allow collective-memory agent authors to publish
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds kreggscode and Guest453 to the public agent/model publisher allowlist.
- The other three selected authors already have access.
- Preserves previous access removals, including NamanSoni78.
- Addresses #15054.

gist.headline: Two more garden keys
gist.blurb: kreggscode and Guest453 can now publish their collective-memory agents and models. The gatekeeper has checked the names twice, including the ones that should stay outside.
gist.summary: Added kreggscode and Guest453 to the public GitHub publisher allowlist for collective-memory agents and models, while retaining prior access removals including NamanSoni78.
gist.impact: Selected collective-memory authors can now publish through the public agent/model flow, with the existing publisher-access boundaries preserved.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden gate represents the public publishing allowlist: Polli, wearing a tiny librarian hat, checks a handwritten contributor list while welcoming two new code-seed packets into a flourishing agent garden. A small dark-purple notice on the gate indicates that existing access boundaries remain intact, with code-plants and a friendly CRT robot representing published agents and models.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny librarian hat, opening a lime green (#ecf874) garden gate for two glowing code-seed packets labeled “kreggscode” and “Guest453,” while a friendly CRT monitor robot tends blooming code-plants behind the gate. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, with a small pixel-font sign reading “PUBLISHERS” and dark purple (#110518) outlines; nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
